selectionEntries.name: Chapter

modifiers.value: Chapter is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Chapter entries, then select Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, or Salamanders on the remaining entry.

selectionEntries.comment: CHAPTER CONFIGURATION SCAFFOLD. The PDF requires one of Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, or Salamanders during list building. Ultramarines is the listbuilder's presentation default because it is the first chapter listed in the source; this is not an additional rules statement. Future chapter-specific units should use safe-hide plus constructive wrong-Chapter validation against these stable option IDs.

catalogue.comment:
SPACE MARINES REV1 / GS18 — VEHICLE SCAFFOLD ONLY.
This catalogue is intentionally incomplete. It exists to establish the Space Marine Chapter selector, Chapter presentation semantics, Space Marines Vehicles presentation, stable vehicle unit IDs, source points/type/class metadata, and Additional Copy Costs infrastructure before any vehicle loadouts or rules are implemented. No Infantry, Leader, Troop, chapter-exclusive non-vehicle unit, weapon choice, paid wargear, unit rule, attachment rule, relic, psychic power, or other gameplay payload is implemented in this revision. The army rules PDF remains authoritative.

REV2 — MANUFACTORUM-READY VEHICLE SCAFFOLD
Aligned native vehicle presentation with the established Astra Militarum / Manufactorum bridge pattern. All eleven native Space Marine vehicle shells now present under Other while retaining their existing Space Marines Vehicles category links as non-primary compatibility tags. The ten chapter-independent vehicle shells are mirrored into Manufactorum Imperium V6 using the same unit IDs. Baal Predator remains local to Space Marines / Blood Angels and is not exported through Manufactorum.
